name: Haruki Murakami
bio: Japanese writer known for works blending surrealism, magical realism, and themes of loneliness.

name: J.K. Rowling
bio: British author, best known for the Harry Potter series which became a worldwide phenomenon.

name: George R.R. Martin
bio: American novelist, screenwriter, and creator of 'A Song of Ice and Fire', adapted into Game of Thrones.

name: Nguyễn Nhật Ánh
bio: Vietnamese author known for children's and young adult literature, with works like 'Kính vạn hoa'.

name: Ernest Hemingway
bio: American novelist and Nobel Prize winner, famous for 'The Old Man and the Sea'.

name: Jane Austen
bio: English novelist known for 'Pride and Prejudice' and sharp social commentary.

name: F. Scott Fitzgerald
bio: American novelist, widely regarded for 'The Great Gatsby' and his portrayal of the Jazz Age.

name: Leo Tolstoy
bio: Russian author of epic novels like 'War and Peace' and 'Anna Karenina'.

name: Mark Twain
bio: American humorist and novelist, best known for 'The Adventures of Tom Sawyer' and 'Huckleberry Finn'.

name: Gabriel García Márquez
bio: Colombian novelist and Nobel laureate, master of magical realism, author of 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'.
